Add purposeful elegant entrance furnishings at believable adult scale: (1) a substantial round carved walnut welcome table on a fitted oval burgundy rug in the LOWER LEFT floor quadrant, with a vase of pale flowers, a small silver calling-card tray and a closed guest book; (2) an upholstered burgundy bench with carved wood legs in the LOWER RIGHT floor quadrant, facing toward the viewer and with natural adult seat height; (3) a slim period wooden coat stand with two hanging coats beside a solid left wall segment, and a distinct small umbrella stand nearby. These should form coherent separate furnishing clusters, not random clutter. Leave the long CENTRAL RUNNER fully clear from north front door down to south threshold. Leave generous unobstructed east-west circulation just in front of the side doors so moving between rooms is easy; don't block doorframes or put furniture on thresholds. Keep floor approaches to the clock, windows, chair and all new furniture clear. Keep the bench, welcome table and other objects separate and identifiable for later furniture IDs and seated character poses. The new bench seat should be comparable in usable height to the existing armchair. Preserve richly shaded detailed pixel clusters, warm brass lighting, dark teal slate and walnut late-Victorian atmosphere; no photorealism. One opaque 1536x1024 image, no characters, labels, UI or border.
